title: Label: a Super Tuscan IGT
scenario: **Podere del Vento** · **Ventoso** · Toscana · **Indicazione Geografica Tipica** · **2019** · Cabernet Sauvignon – Merlot – Sangiovese · 14% vol · 750 ml

questions.explanation: A brand name added beyond the designation. Podere del Vento is the producer; Toscana IGT is the classification.

questions.stem: What does **Indicazione Geografica Tipica** say about this wine?
choices: it is a table wine made to no specification
it holds Italy's highest guaranteed designation
it is quality wine made outside the DOC rules
it is the largest and most medium-quality class
questions.explanation: IGT: usually quality wine that does not need to comply with DOC/DOCG rules — the Super Tuscan home (Tignanello, Solaia are Rosso IGT).

questions.stem: Being IGT, this wine sits above DOC in Italy's classification.
questions.explanation: The ladder is DOCG › DOC › IGT › VdT. IGT is below DOC as a class, though the wine can be excellent.

questions.stem: In which Italian region is this wine made?
Which Tuscan coastal zone is known for this Bordeaux-style blend under its own DOC?
questions.explanation: Bolgheri DOC (and Maremma Toscana): Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, with Sangiovese, on sandy-clay soil like Bordeaux. Montefalco is Umbria.
